# TRACE (trace-sec)

> TRACE is an open-source security scanner (npm: trace-sec, CLI: trace) that audits a backend repository in under a
> second on local CPU with zero tokens: multi-framework AST adapters build an in-memory Attack-Path Model, hypotheses
> are tested with live OWASP testpacks, and SecureBERT 2.0 + AST dataflow + probe evidence fuse into calibrated
> confidence. Findings (TR-BOLA, TR-BFLA, TR-AUTH, TR-SSRF, TR-INJ, TR-MASS, TR-TRAV, TR-SSTI, TR-CORS, TR-DESER) are
> served to AI coding agents over MCP, and a verification oracle (FIXED / STILL_PRESENT / INCONCLUSIVE) replays exploits
> to prove fixes. Only analyzable source languages are read; markup, styles and data/config files are skipped. Lite
> install runs on 4 GB with no torch; full install adds neural scoring. Apache-2.0.

Minimal use:

```bash
npx trace-sec audit .
trace scan ./backend --target http://localhost:8000
trace explain TR-BOLA-001
trace verify TR-BOLA-001 --target http://localhost:8000
```

MCP: `claude mcp add trace -- npx -y trace-sec mcp` — tools `trace_scan`, `trace_status`, `trace_findings`,
`trace_explain`, `trace_attack_path`, `trace_verify`, `trace_harness_task`, `trace_eval_patch`.

Agent skills (any harness, open SKILL.md format): `npx skills add VK-Amogh/TRACE --skill trace`, or `npx trace-sec install-skill`.
Skills: `trace` (set up, configure and run TRACE; the only one a user must install) and `trace-fix` (triage, prioritize, fix, verify, report).
